name: find_games
description: Find the games, areas and simulations that a short description of a situation points to, from the words in it. Use this first when someone describes a situation in their own words.

description.description: a few words or a sentence describing the situation

name: get_game
description: Get one game: its summary, how it works, its strategies, pitfalls, and its payoff table if it has one.

game.description: a game id such as prisoners-dilemma, or its name

name: list_games
description: List every game with its id, name and category, or only the games in one area.

area.description: optional area name, such as Work games

name: solve_matrix
description: Analyse a two-player payoff matrix: dominance steps, surviving strategies, maximin values and every equilibrium (for matrices up to 4 by 4).

matrix.description: rows separated by ";", each cell "yours,theirs", e.g. "3,3 0,5; 5,0 1,1"

name: list_simulations
description: List the simulations. Basic simulations are fixed choices you can read; live simulations have an opponent who replies to each move.

name: get_simulation
description: Get a simulation's summary, its path to victory and its path to failure as chances, and how many endings it has.

name: repeat_summary
description: Describe repeated play of a game against a bot for a number of rounds: the bot's rule, and the best plan of always choosing the same option. Does not play the rounds.

game.description: a game id that has a payoff table
